program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if h % 2 == 1 and all(v == grid[h // 2][0] for v in grid[h // 2]):
        a, b = grid[:h // 2], grid[h // 2 + 1:]
    elif w % 2 == 1 and all(grid[r][w // 2] == grid[0][w // 2] for r in range(h)):
        a = [row[:w // 2] for row in grid]
        b = [row[w // 2 + 1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        raise ValueError('no centered separator')
    common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    color = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(len(a))]
'''
